bunker (CC-BY 3.0, modified 2026-11-27): each of the 9 boots clips (swuing footstep-concrete.wav) with Kenney Impact Sounds footstep_concrete (CC0) high-passed and mixed in very quietly (gain 0.06) 35 ms before it as a faint heel tap - used for the shelter floor.
